title: 位置编码对比：正弦 vs 可学习 vs RoPE 相对位置性质
expected_output:
正弦 PE shape: (6, 8)
位置0与位置1 L2 距离: 0.9641
可学习 PE shape: (6, 8)  位置0范数: 0.0574
RoPE 相对距离=2 内积(应全相等): [-2.147123, -2.147123, -2.147123, -2.147123]
RoPE 全部相等: True
加法式绝对PE 同相对距离内积(应不等): [4.810112, 4.590129, 5.194545, 5.951971]
加法式绝对PE 全部相等: False
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
d = 8
T = 6
pos = np.arange(T)[:, None]
i = np.arange(d)[None, :]
angle = pos / (10000.0 ** (2 * (i // 2) / d))
sin_pe = np.zeros((T, d))
sin_pe[:, 0::2] = np.sin(angle[:, 0::2])
sin_pe[:, 1::2] = np.cos(angle[:, 1::2])
print("正弦 PE shape:", sin_pe.shape)
print("位置0与位置1 L2 距离:", round(float(np.linalg.norm(sin_pe[0] - sin_pe[1])), 4))
learn_pe = rng.standard_normal((T, d)) * 0.02
print("可学习 PE shape:", learn_pe.shape, " 位置0范数:", round(float(np.linalg.norm(learn_pe[0])), 4))

def rope(x, p):
    half = d // 2
    x1 = x[..., :half]
    x2 = x[..., half:]
    ang = p / (10000.0 ** (np.arange(half) / (d / 2.0)))
    c = np.cos(ang); s = np.sin(ang)
    return np.concatenate([x1 * c - x2 * s, x1 * s + x2 * c], axis=-1)

q = rng.standard_normal(d)
k = rng.standard_normal(d)
def rot_dot(m, n):
    return float(np.dot(rope(q, m), rope(k, n)))
vals = [round(rot_dot(m, n), 6) for (m, n) in [(2, 0), (3, 1), (4, 2), (5, 3)]]
print("RoPE 相对距离=2 内积(应全相等):", vals)
print("RoPE 全部相等:", len(set(vals)) == 1)
# 对照：朴素「加法式绝对位置编码」把 PE 向量直接加到 q/k 上，
# 其内积含 q.PE[n] 与 PE[m].k 绝对项，故依赖绝对位置而非仅相对距离
def abs_dot(m, n):
    return float(np.dot(q + sin_pe[m], k + sin_pe[n]))
av = [round(abs_dot(m, n), 6) for (m, n) in [(2, 0), (3, 1), (4, 2), (5, 3)]]
print("加法式绝对PE 同相对距离内积(应不等):", av)
print("加法式绝对PE 全部相等:", len(set(av)) == 1)
